title_en: Target Just Dropped a Massive Pokémon TCG Restock Featuring Rare 30th Anniversary ETBs at MSRP—Here Is How to Grab Yours Before They Sell Out
summary_en: Target just dropped a massive Pokémon TCG restock featuring rare 30th anniversary ETBs at MSRP and loads more — here is how to grab yours before they sell out.
body_en:
Been looking to get some Pokémon TCG sets at MSRP? Well, the chance doesn't come around very often. If you're fast enough, you can bag some fresh restocks of the latest expansions from Target today (September 25) , as the major US retailer is going through a fresh batch of stock online.
That includes 30th anniversary sets, Pitch Black booster bundles, Ascended Heroes sticker collections, and a whole lot more.
Obviously, most of us will be hunting down the 30th Anniversary Celebration ETBs for $69.99. While Amazon has invite requests up for $89.99 , that extra $20 saving wouldn't be so bad. Plus, compared to resale market prices that sit around $200 right now, either would be a result in my eyes.
But my favorite deal from the current selection is the Pitch Black booster bundle for just $31.99. While Amazon did have these down to $39.99 recently, saving that little bit extra is well worth trying for, as this is the best price I've seen on these so far this year. Six boosters included, which means you're paying just $5.31 per pack, which is a bargain in the current market.
Sticker collections for Ascended Heroes are also just $19.99, with a choice of Gastly or Charmander. Great price on both of these as well.
As a reminder as well, the restocks for each of these sets are coming in short saves right now, so even if it says it's out of stock, keep freshing to checking back in, as stock will keep appearing throughout today and possibly this weekend as well.
Amazon has recently restocked its allocation of Pokémon TCG's 30th Celebration Booster Bundles , which are currently available for just $45. That's considerably under current market rates, which sit around $122.64 at TCGplayer .
If you're struggling to add to basket, click the "See All Buying Options" prompt, and it should allow you to preorder the bundle from "Amazon.com". That's sold and shipped by Amazon, not a third-party seller.
Plus, just like Target, Amazon is restocking these in short waves, so my suggestion is to add to your wishlist and keep checking back whenever you can.
The 30th anniversary set has been remarkably hard to get hold of ever since preorders went live. The set is now officially available globally, but that doesn't mean the hunt for boosters slows down any time soon.
To nobody’s surprise, the secondary market for the new set is in absolute, unadulterated chaos. Queues have stretched out the IRL doors as long as a Cycling Lane at retailers across the world .
For now, to give you an idea of where the dust is settling, we’ve also recently pulled the median market prices per TCGplayer for the top 10 highest-value cards in the set , so you know what to look out for when ripping packs. See those just below, and good luck!
Robert Anderson is a Senior Commerce Editor for IGN. Based in London, UK, he is a qualified journalist with a Bachelor of Arts in Journalism (First Class Degree) and over seven years of professional writing and editing experience.
You can usually find Robert lost in open-world RPG games like Elden Ring and Cyberpunk 2077. Outside of gaming, his passions include reading comics (especially Superman, Batman, and Spider-Man), taking photos, and keeping up with the latest in film and TV.
His primary coverage focuses on tracking down the best gaming deals and diving into the fast-paced world of Trading Card Games (TCGs). He regularly covers everything from the latest releases in Pokémon TCG and the most expensive cards to comprehensive Magic: The Gathering buying guides .
